scripts.dev:alquileres: bash scripts/tunel-bilbo.sh -d && SISTEMA=alquileres NEXT_DIST_DIR=.next-alquileres next dev -H 0.0.0.0 -p 3000
scripts.dev:cerveceria: bash scripts/tunel-bilbo.sh -d && SISTEMA=cerveceria NEXT_DIST_DIR=.next-cerveceria next dev -H 0.0.0.0 -p 3001
scripts.dev:ambos: bash scripts/tunel-bilbo.sh -d && (npm run dev:alquileres & npm run dev:cerveceria & wait)
scripts.start:alquileres: bash scripts/tunel-bilbo.sh -d && SISTEMA=alquileres NEXT_DIST_DIR=.next-alquileres next start -H 0.0.0.0 -p 3000
scripts.start:cerveceria: bash scripts/tunel-bilbo.sh -d && SISTEMA=cerveceria NEXT_DIST_DIR=.next-cerveceria next start -H 0.0.0.0 -p 3001
scripts.demo:build: cross-env NEXT_DIST_DIR=.next-alquileres next build && cross-env NEXT_DIST_DIR=.next-cerveceria next build
scripts.demo:datos: prisma db push --accept-data-loss && tsx prisma/seed.ts && tsx prisma/seed-cerveceria.ts
